title: Read a checked path number
summary: Django: Read a checked path number. Try /double/cat/.
introduction: The int converter turns a matching path part into a Python int. Open GET /double/4/.
learningObjectives: Read a checked path number with Django

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Read a checked path number

blocks.text: The int converter matches 4 and passes integer n to the view. The multiplication returns 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A nonmatching converter produces 404 before the view runs.
